subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

**Triumph**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Failure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Triumph"** refers to a great victory or achievement. It signifies success or a sense of accomplishment. (विजय)

 
 
• **Example: **The team celebrated their triumph after winning the championship.
 
 
 
• **"Failure" **is the antonym of triumph and refers to the lack of success or the inability to achieve a desired goal. (असफलता)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite repeated failures, she never gave up on her dreams.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **'Triumph' **is **'Failure'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Failure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lapse** (चूक): A temporary failure of concentration, memory, or judgment.

 
 
• **Example: **Her lapse in judgment caused her to make a poor decision during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Attentiveness** (ध्यान): The trait of being observant and paying close attention.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher appreciated the student’s attentiveness in class.
 
 
 
• **Delay** (विलंब): The act of postponing or causing something to occur later than planned.
 
 
• **Example: **There was a delay in the flight due to bad weather.
